product_overview: EAMSagemCom is an Enterprise Asset Management platform extended with ML predictive maintenance services, technician/manager workflows, and inventory & notification integrations to reduce downtime and optimize maintenance operations.
core_goals: Provide reliable ML-based predictions (failure probability, failure type, RUL, anomaly detection) for machines to enable predictive maintenance.
Offer role-based operations for request handling and work order lifecycle (CHETOP, CHEFTECH, Technicien) with planning and inventory support.
Expose a stable API surface for dashboards, notifications (SSE), and integrations while ensuring operational health visibility.
Deliver clear happy-path and error behaviors for all public endpoints and identify critical security gaps to be addressed (authentication on ML/inventory, CORS, token refresh).

features.name: Health Check
features.description: System-level health endpoints to verify service and database connectivity.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 {"status":"ok"} -> GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 200 {"status":"ok","database":"connected"}
GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 503 {"status":"error","database":"unreachable"}

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User registration, login and retrieval of current user using JWTs (note: refresh endpoint is currently a stub).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with body {nom, email, mot_de_passe, role} -> Receive 201 {message, user} -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {email, mot_de_passe} -> Receive 200 {access_token, refresh_token, token_type} -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {id, nom, email, role}
POST /api/v1/auth/register with body using existing email -> Receive 409 Email already exists
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with body {refresh_token} -> Receive 401 (refresh endpoint stub / not implemented)

features.name: Machine Learning Predictions
features.description: ML endpoints provide machine-level predictions (RUL, failure probability/type, health scores), fleet dashboards and retraining triggers.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/ml/machines/{machine_id}/prediction -> Receive 200 {machine_id, machine_name, rul_days, risk_level, failure_probability, health_score, reliability_score, is_anomaly, explanations}
GET /api/v1/ml/machines/{machine_id}/prediction -> Receive 404 {error: "Machine not found"}
GET /api/v1/ml/machines/{machine_id}/failure-probability -> Receive 200 {failure_probability, risk_level} -> GET /api/v1/ml/machines/{machine_id}/failure-type -> Receive 200 {TWF, HDF, PWF, OSF, RNF}
GET /api/v1/ml/fleet/critical -> Receive 200 {machines: [...] } -> GET /api/v1/ml/fleet/dashboard -> Receive 200 {total_machines, critical_count, high_count, machines: [...] }
POST /api/v1/ml/retrain -> Receive 200 {status, message}
POST /api/v1/ml/retrain -> Receive 500 {status: "error", message: "retraining failed"}

features.name: CHETOP Operations
features.description: Manager-level intervention request submission and machine listing for CHETOP staff (requires authentication).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {email, mot_de_passe} -> Receive 200 {access_token, refresh_token, token_type} -> GET /api/v1/chetop/dashboard with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {total_requests, pending_requests, total_machines}
POST /api/v1/chetop/intervention-requests with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body {machine_id, problem_description, priority} -> Receive 201 {id, status, created_at}
GET /api/v1/chetop/machines with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total}
POST /api/v1/chetop/intervention-requests without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: CHEFTECH Operations
features.description: Chef Technique workflows: dashboard, listing/approval of interventions and work order assignment (requires authentication).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {email, mot_de_passe} -> Receive 200 {access_token, refresh_token, token_type} -> GET /api/v1/cheftech/dashboard with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {total_work_orders, pending_interventions, total_techniciens, total_machines}

GET /api/v1/cheftech/interventions with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total} -> POST /api/v1/cheftech/interventions/{intervention_id}/approve with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {id, status: "approved"}
POST /api/v1/cheftech/ordres-travail/{ordre_id}/assign with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body {technician_ids} -> Receive 200 {ordre_id, assigned_to: [...] }
POST /api/v1/cheftech/interventions/{invalid_id}/approve with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 404 Intervention not found

features.name: TECHNICIEN Operations
features.description: Technician endpoints for viewing assigned interventions/work orders and updating work order status (requires authentication).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {email, mot_de_passe} -> Receive 200 {access_token, refresh_token, token_type} -> GET /api/v1/technicien/interventions with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total}

GET /api/v1/technicien/work-orders with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total} -> PATCH /api/v1/technicien/work-orders/{order_id}/start with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {order_id, status: "in_progress"} -> PATCH /api/v1/technicien/work-orders/{order_id}/complete with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body {pdca_data} -> Receive 200 {order_id, status: "completed", pdca: {...}}
PATCH /api/v1/technicien/work-orders/{order_id}/start with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> for an order not assigned to the user -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Plannings
features.description: Create and list maintenance plannings; results filtered by user roles (requires authentication).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {email, mot_de_passe} -> Receive 200 {access_token, refresh_token, token_type} -> GET /api/v1/plannings with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total}

POST /api/v1/plannings with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body {identifiant_planning, date_debut, date_fin, type, user_ids, machine_ids} -> Receive 201 {id, identifiant_planning, date_debut, date_fin}
POST /api/v1/plannings with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body missing required fields -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Spare parts and stock management APIs (currently public/no authentication).
user_flows: GET /api/v1/inventory/stock -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total} -> GET /api/v1/inventory/pieces -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total}
POST /api/v1/inventory/stock with body {piece_id, quantity} -> Receive 201 {id, piece_id, quantity, updated_at}
POST /api/v1/inventory/stock with body {piece_id, quantity: -5} -> Receive 400 Validation error (quantity must be positive)

features.name: Notifications
features.description: User notifications (SSE for real-time) with listing, unread count and mark-as-read operations (requires authentication).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {email, mot_de_passe} -> Receive 200 {access_token, refresh_token, token_type} -> GET /api/v1/notifications with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {items: [...], total}

GET /api/v1/notifications/unread-count with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 {count: 3} -> POST /api/v1/notifications/mark-as-read with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> and body {notification_ids: [...]} -> Receive 200 {updated: [...]}
GET /api/v1/notifications without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
